description: This file is a Perl script that generates ARM assembly code for AES encryption/decryption routines optimized for ARMv8 architecture, supporting both 32-bit and 64-bit modes, with specific code for different ARM cores and instruction sets. It includes functions for setting encryption keys, performing block encryption/decryption, and CTR mode encryption, with detailed handling of ARM-specific instructions and errata workarounds.

methods.name: gen_block
methods.description: Generates assembly routines for AES block encryption and decryption for ARM architecture, supporting both encryption and decryption modes.
